title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - CommunicationProtocol
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/CommunicationProtocol. A protocol is an agreement between the communicating parties on how communication is to proceed (definition taken from Tanenbaum, Computer Networks, 4th ed.). Subclass of saref4syst:Connection (SAREF4SYST, out of this candidate's scope). Used as the range of usesCommunicationProtocol from saref:Device/saref:DeviceKind entities.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommunicationProtocol'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
